==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I investigated the source of a sudden blizzard. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.)
A kaiju sized snow elemental had come to steal my Reality Warping Stone. (The Snow Kaiju Elemental resembled a giant faceless humanoid made of snow surrounded by a sparkling blue energy aura infused with snowflakes.)
I defeated it by turning my body into magma and flying through the beast like a missile.
